property_summary: For any admissible input, a successful transferFrom on token id transfers ownership, i.e. ownerOf(id) becomes the recipient `to`; the mutant never updates _ownerOf, so ownerOf(id) remains the previous owner for some id.

For any admissible order filled via fillOrder, every minted position id is owned by its recipient (ownerOf(id) == recipient); the mutant never writes _ownerOf, so ownerOf reverts/returns zero for some minted position.

After any admissible fillOrder, both minted positions are actually registered in _ownerOf, so the fill recipient can later transfer its position via transferFrom; the mutant never writes _ownerOf, so that transferFrom reverts for some input.
